caption: The drawing shows a wooden bucket composed of vertical slats held together by two horizontal metal bands, one near the top and one near the bottom. The bucket features a curved handle attached to the sides with fasteners, and the wood appears weathered with a light beige color on the outside and a darker brown interior. There are visible water stains on the wood, particularly along the bottom edge and partially up the slats. The metal bands are depicted with rust-colored shading and two prominent bolts or rivets are seen on the band near the handle. The entire object is set against a plain, light background.
title: Bucket
